title: French Stew
description: A hearty French stew made with tender vegetables and a rich broth. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, red wine, and vegetable broth.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with thyme and serve hot.
